text: Tobi ordered lunch from Ada’s Kitchen. He taps Orders on You.
Every order and booking with any business is here, newest first.
He taps Ada’s Kitchen to open his order.
The order shows what he got, the total and who has it.
Under Delivery, the steps show the rider has picked it up.
Minutes later, he pulls down to refresh. The steps now show the rider at his door.
He goes back. In Orders, the row says At the door too.
